historical_full_stack_replays.interpretation: Font-specific historical recording omitted the inventory queue. Its loss count is unknown, not evidence of an actual loss. No missing channel was backfilled.
Repeated replay reproduced the same evidence-gap stop. This is not a clean shadow kill.

native_baseline.limitation: Thirty acquisition samples only; the supervisor stopped on foreground ownership and did not accept thirty clean frames. This is not a combat performance benchmark.

physical_stop_check.scope: User pressed the registered Windows hotkey; the read-only helper latched the supervisor stop and closed the recording backend. No held hardware keys or combat actions were tested.
physical_stop_check.previous_pause_attempt: Expired without foreground/key evidence; not counted as passed.

runtime_scope.foundation_movement_plus_hit_validation: Completed in docs/validation/profile-unification.json: 53 tiles, 19 player hit events and zero player-hit losses in one 75-second session.
